༄༅/ /nam mkha' klong yangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rin chen shog skya'i skor/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /nam mkha' klong yangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

rin chen shog skya'i skor/ nam mkha' klong yangs zhes bya ba/ rang bzhin gdod ma'i mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye nas ma bcos gzhi rdzogs gnyug ma'i ngang*/ /bltar med bsam yul 'das pa'i rig pa ni/ /gang ltar snang yang de ltar ma grub pa/ /rang shar rang sar grol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir ni skye med lhun rdzogs snying po'i don/ /rang bzhin byas pa med pa'i chos nyid la/ /sus kyang bcos su med pa rnal ma'i don/ /ji ltar bdag gis rtogs bzhin bshad kyis nyon/ /dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med pa'i sems nyid 'di/ /rang bzhin gdod nas stong pa'i chos sku ste/ /'di zhes mi mtshon lta ba'i rgyal po mchog /rtsa bral stong pa legs par mkhyen par mdzod/ /gang gis ma sgrib gnyis med rig pa'i sems/ /rang shar ye nas dag pa'i 'od gsal te/ / gang babs ngang bzhag sgom pa'i rgyal po mchog /dran bsam blo las 'das par mkhyen par mdzod/ /gnyis med blang dor bral ba'i rig pa 'di/ /shar grol 'dzin med yangs pa'i sprul sku ste/ /shugs 'byung 'gags med spyod pa'i rgyal po mchog /cir snang dgag sgrub med par mkhyen par mdzod/ /re dogs 'bad rtsol zhig pa'i sems nyid 'di/ /ma byas lhun gyis grub pa'i chos nyid de/ /ye grol phyam brdal 'bras bu'i rgyal po mchog /gdod ma'i zad sar legs par mkhyen par mdzod/ /snang sems thams cad rig pa'i cho 'phrul te/ /rig pa'i rang bzhin skye med nam mkha'i ngang*/ /gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i byung khungs zad pa yin/ /de ltar rtogs na gzhi bral chos sku ste/ /'di zhes ched 'dzin zhig na mthong ba yin/ /ha ha grogs dag gang babs rig pa'i gnad/ /gang yin yin gyis sems kyi tshol 'phro zhog /'di yin med kyis dmigs gtad zhen pa thong*/ /yin min med kyis phyogs lhung 'dzin pa dor/ /gza' gtad med kyis dgag sgrub 'phro ma mthud/ /kye ho phyam cig chos sku'i don la nyon/

/nan ltar byas na dgag sgrub gzhi gnas med/ /gzung ba'i yul med 'dzin pa'i sems med de/ /bya rgyu'i chos med lta sgom spyod 'bras med/ /thams cad phyam cig ye nas byang chub bo/ /ho ho 'khor 'das sgyu ma'i rtsed mo la/ /don med bden par bzung bas 'gro ba 'khrul/ /smig rgyu'i chu la ri dwags snyegs pa bzhin/ /nam yang dngos po med pa'i chos kyis bslus/ /med snang 'khrul pas bcings pa'i 'gro ba kun/ / grong khyer drug tu yun ring 'khyams pa ni/ /sgyu ma'i skyes bu nam mkha'i zhags pas bzung*/ /rmi lam grong du bde sdug myong ba bzhin/ /med bzhin snang la 'dzin pas sdug bsngal lo/ /kye ma dus ring 'khor ba'i grong khyer na/ /'gro drug 'khrul pa'i sems can nyon re mongs/ /thog mtha' dus med sems can snying re rje/ /rang snang 'khrul pa'i snang ba spang re dka'/ /bzod dka'i bag chags sna tshogs snyugs re ring*/ /thar dka' srid pa'i rgya mtsho nam zhig brgal/ /'on kyang bde gshegs thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis/ /srid pa'i chu gter sgrol la thag mi ring*/ /he he de kun mdang sum rmi lam 'dra/ /med snang 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin rtogs pas grol/ /rang snang yin pas logs su spangs mi dgos/ /sbrul 'khrul thag pa rang bzhin shes pas grol/ /sgyu ma'i rang bzhin mthong bas blo bde 'o/ /ha ha grogs dag chos nyid phyam brdal lo/ /bya rgyu byed mkhan med pa'i sems nyid la/ /'khrul gzhi 'khrul mkhan med pas nyams re dga'/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin gzhi nas med pa ste/ / rags par snang ba gzhig na rdul phran la/ /de yang cha med dngos por ye nas med/ /'khor bya 'khor byed 'khor ba'i rang bzhin stong*/ /med snang 'khrul ba'i sems la bltas pas kyang*/ kha dog dbyibs med dus gsum phyi nang med/ /sems zhes btags kyang 'dogs mkhan bltas pas stong*/ /btsal bas ma rnyed dngos med nam mkha' 'dra/

/gzung 'dzin sgrib pa gzhi bral gang la brten/ /las dang bag chags rtsa ba stong pas na/ /de la 'khor ba 'khor mkhan soms dang kye/ /de ltar gzhig cing legs par dpyad pa'i tshe/ /mya ngan med pas mya ngan 'das pa'ang med/ /de ltar 'khor 'das gzhi nas med pa la/ /blang dor gnyis 'dzin re dogs skye bo 'khrul/ /ma bkrol gzhi nas grol ba'i chos nyid la/ /'bad cing rtsol ba'i 'gro ba thang re chad/ /de nyid rtogs pa'i don la sgom med par/ /lta sgom spyod pa'i nyams kyis rnal 'byor 'ching*/ /ji tsam 'bad pa de tsam sgrib pa ste/ /gnas lugs 'ching ba'i gzeb yin dgos pa med/ /re dogs ched 'dzin zhig na gnyug ma'i don/ /gang shar rtogs pa'i grogs yin ngo mtshar che/ /grogs dag gnad kyi me long bstan gyis ltos/ /sgom med don de bsgoms pas mthong mi 'gyur/ /dpyad pas mi shes rtog pa'i gzebs las 'das/ /sgom med bsgoms na sgom pa'i gzeb tu 'ching*/ /gom pas phyin na 'gro 'ong mi 'chad bzhin/ /ma bsgom lhug pa tha mal sems la 'char/ /rang sar bsdad na 'gro 'ong med pa bzhin/ /dpyad kyang mi mthong rtog pa'i 'phro 'du nyid/ /zhen pa'i phreng thag yin pas dgos pa med/ /gnas lugs don la sems kyi dran bsam zhog /ma bsam ma dpyad tha mal rig pa'i gnad/ /'gyus pas 'gags la snang bas rang sar grol/ /dran 'dzin gnyen po mi dgos rang grol yin/ /chags sdang la sogs rtog tshogs snga ma rnams/ /bltas dang glod pas rang grol yin snyam yang*/ /phyi ma'i tshe na snga ma 'gags pa ni/ / gshis kyi gnas lugs yin pa mi shes sam/ /rtog pa snga phyi dus gcig mi sdod pas/ /snga ma 'gag phyir bsgoms pa ngan med ngal/ /phyi ma'i sems kyang rtog las ma 'das pas/ /rtog la rtog mthud thag rul 'breng rul 'dra/ sems rgyun snga phyi dus gcig gnyis mi srid/ /phyi ma'i dus na snga ma 'gags nas med/ /de bas snga ma'i rtog tshogs grol bya'i phyir/

/phyi ma'i sems kyis grol kyang rang grol min/ /snga phyi yin phyir gzhan grol shes pa la/ /rang grol nyid ces 'dzin pa blun po'i blo/ /ba glang skyong zhes logs na ci zhig yod/ / gzhan yang snga ma'i sems la phyi mas blta/ /rtog pa'i 'phro mthud yin pas lu gu rgyud/ /mi g.yo bsam gtan mchog las rgyang ring 'gyur/ /zhi gnas lhag mthog zung 'jug mnyam gzhag kyang*/ /rtog pa'i 'phrau gnas mnyam sbyor gnas pa tsam/ /gzhi bral don gyi rtogs pa ma skyes na/ /gong ma'i skye gnas nyid las 'da' mi nus/ /rtog pa 'gag phyir sgom pa'ang gnas lugs min/ /bkag pas mi khegs sngon las rags par 'char/ /rdzing bu'i chu bzhin nam zhig nyon mongs grogs/ /chos kun ye nas rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid/ /'di zhes mi mtshon gza' gtad med pa la/ /blo yis bcos shing bsgyur bas bslad pa yin/ /gang ltar shar yang de ltar ma grub pas/ /sna tshogs shar yang rang grol gnyug ma'i ngang*/ /chu dang rlabs bzhin ye shes rgya mtsho'i ngang*/ /rtog med gnas kyang ma bcos chos nyid dang*/ /res shar res 'gag gzhi klong yangs pa'i ngang*/ /dgag sgrub mi dgos rang shar gdod ma'i ngang*/ /mi 'gyur gzhi yi dgongs klong yangs pa yin/ /sna tshogs chos rnams sgyu mar mthong ba dang*/ /'dzin pa'i sems la dgag sgrub zhig pa dang*/ /'di yin gza' gtad rdul tsam med pa'i tshe/ /phyi nang chos rnams stong par rtogs pa yin/ /gang shar chos la ci dgar rol pas chog /mkha' la rdzas bzhin kun gyis gos pa med/ /zas nor rnyed kun zhen pa med pa dang*/ /bstod smad sgra rnams brag char rtogs pa dang*/ /dgra gnyen chags sdang gnyis 'dzin med pa'i tshe/ /dgag sgrub 'khrul pa'i ri bo zhig pa yin/ /snang srid gang dga'i ngos la de ltar thongs/ /sbrul mdud bzhin de rang sa rang gis grol/ /kun las bdag nyid dman par mthong ba dang*/ / snying nas mi rtag blo sna thung ba dang*/

/'khor ba'i chos la nges 'byung skyes pa'i tshe/ /chos kyi sems la legs par phan pa yin/ /tshul 'chos mi dgos spyod lam rnal mar bya/ /dbang po'i gtso bo rang sems zol med yin/ /sna tshogs mdzad spyod dgongs par shes pa dang*/ /snying nas mos gus rgyun chad med pa dang*/ /rtogs pa'i rten 'brel sems la 'char ba dang*/ byams dang snying rje phyogs ris med pa dang*/ /chos mdzad rnams la dag snang skyes pa'i tshe/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs pa yin/ /rang snang dag pas gzhan don ngang gis 'grub/ /dngos grub sprin tshogs nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /'khor 'das dgag sgrub re dogs zhig pa dang*/ /bde sdug rkyen ngan lam du longs pa dang*/ /the tshom khu 'phrig snyems thag chod pa'i tshe/ /rtogs pa'i nyi ma nang nas shar ba yin/ /rang snang dngos la gza' gtad kun bral bas/ /zang thal rig pa thog babs btang bas chos/ /gang yang bde klong gcig tu 'khyil ba yin/ /kye ho grogs dag bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /ye nas ma skyes rmi lam sgyu ma la/ /snang zhing srid pa thams cad chos nyid ngang*/ /rtogs dang mi rtog ye nas mnyam pa nyid/ /dag dang ma dag de bzhin gnyis su med/ / sgyu ma'i grong na bde sdug snang ba bzhin/ /med snang 'gro ba drug ces btags pa tsam/ /sna tshogs snang yang ye nas dag pa'i zhing*/ /mngon par byang chub gzhi klong yangs pa yin/ /rba rlabs ri bo 'dra ba rgya mtsho'i ngang*/ /dran rig bde sdug sna tshogs sems nyid ngang*/ /sems nyid nam mkha' 'dra ba chos nyid ngang*/ /chos nyid ye nas ma skyes stong pa'i ngang*/ /stong pa phyam brdal gzhi rdzogs snying po 'o/ /kye ho lhun rdzogs mnyam nyid gdod ma'i ngang*/ /skye med mkha' klong yangs pa'i nam mkha' la/ /nyi zla gza' skar sprin tshogs grangs med kyang*/ /nam mkha'i ngang bzhin mi g.yo spros dang bral/ /de bzhin sems nyid yangs pa'i nam mkha' la/ /rtogs dang mi rtog snang srid cir shar

yang*/ /thams cad ma skyes rang bzhin spros dang bral/ /'di zhes mi mtshon ngos bzung cung zad med/ /dus gsum mi 'gyur kun tu bzang po'i ngang*/ khyab gdal 'ub chub mtha' grol klong yangs shing*/ /sna tshogs sgyu ma'i rol pa gzigs mor che/ /kye ho 'gro kun rmi lam lta bu ste/ /legs nyes shor thob dgag sgrub ci byung yang*/ /rmi lam nor stor sgyu ma'i rtsed mo bzhin/ /ye nas dgag sgrub shor god ma mthong ngo*/ /sgom nyams drod tshad bzang ngan de dang 'dra/ /sems goms btags pa'i don snang gzugs brnyan la/ /byis pa'i khang bu bzhin du bden par 'dzin/ /de kun bzang ngan rdul tsam ma mthong yang*/ /'jig rten 'khrul la sgom mkhan bzang por rlom/ /a ho thams cad mnyam nyid phyam brdal lo/ /'khrul pa rtogs na ye shes logs na med/ /ma rigs sems de rig pas chos nyid dngos/ /thag pa'i rang bzhin shes pas sbrul 'dzin grol/ /de bzhin snang srid 'khrul snang gzugs brnyan tsam/ /yod med spros pa'i yul las 'das pa yin/ /'dir ni gcig tu nges pa'i blos dpyad de/ /sna tshogs snang ba'i yul la phar bltas pas/ / rmi lam sgyu ma gnyis med chos sku'i ngang*/ /gzung ba'i yul med 'dzin pa'i sems med do/ /de nyid 'byed pa'i blo la tshur bltas pas/ /lta mkhan ma grub gzung 'dzin mkhan po stor/ /yul sems gnyis med gdod ma'i ngang du grol/ /ha ha 'gro kun 'khor ba'i grong khyer na/ /'ching dang grol med nam mkha'i mdud pa bzhin/ /thams cad ye nas rdzogs sangs rgyas par mthong*/ /'khor bar 'dzin pa mang tsam glo bur te/ / glo bur rkyen la ngos gzung 'ga' med do/ /thams cad ye nas ma grol gcig kyang med/ / bcings pa 'ga' med ye sangs rgyas pa la/ /'khor 'das gnyis snang 'dzin pa dgod re bro/ /snang srid sgyu ma'i yul la phar bltas pas/ /thams cad phyam phyam gzhi nas grol bar mthong*/ /ya mtshan dgod po bro ba'i snang ba la/

/'dzin med gza' gtad bral ba'i rtogs pa shar/ /snang sems gnyis med sgom dang mi bsgom med/ /lta spyod gnyis med blang dang dor ba med/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis med rmi lam snang ba 'dra/ /de ltar rtogs na rang grol sku yin te/ /lhag par sgom med tha mal gnas pas bde/ /snga phyir mi 'dzin da ltar 'dzin pa zhig /dus gsum dus med dus bzhi mnyam pa nyid/ /thams cad phyam phyam nam mkha'i klong yangs so/ /'gro 'chag nyal 'dug spyod lam thams cad pa/ /rtsis med ris bral ma bcos blo bde 'o/ / so gnyug rnal ma bu chung lta bu ste/ /re dogs gnyis med tshong zin skye bo 'dra/ /blang dang dor med dgag sgrub kun las 'das/ /dus rnams kun tu kun tu bzang po'i ngang*/ /bde chen sa la bde klong gcig tu 'khyil/ /rang bzhin gnyis su med pa'i blo bde 'o/ /e ma grogs dag 'khrul pa nang nas zhig /sku gsum sa la ma phyin lhun gyis grub/ /mdzad pa'i phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /dus gsum rig 'dzin snga phyi dgongs pa gcig /gdod ma'i gzhi la lhun rdzogs blo bde 'o/ /da ni bsam rdzogs ye klong yangs pa'i ngang*/ /chos zad blo zad 'khor 'das 'dzin pa zad/ /rang bzhin lhun 'byams ma bcos gnyug ma'i don/ /rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i chos nyid ni/ /yai grol sor bzhag kun bzang rol pa'i zhing*/ /bzang ngan blang dor re dogs 'das pa ni/ /snang srid ma lus sku gsum 'du 'bral med/ /ye nas phyam cig thams cad chos zad do/ /med snang stong la phyogs ris 'das pa ni/ /ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i 'char tshul te/ /'di zhes ched 'dzin zhig na gdod ma'i ngang*/ /gzhi rdzogs ye grol phyam cig sangs rgyas te/ /sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang nyid do/ /de ltar rtogs na rang snang chos sku'i zhing*/ /ma lus 'gro kun sgyu ma'i sangs rgyas te/ /sna tshogs dran rig ting 'dzin yangs pa'i klong*/

/mi 'gyur gzhi rtsa kun las 'das pa ni/ /'og min gnas su mngon par byang chub yin/ /'di zhes zhen 'dzin yod na 'khor ba ste/ /de la ched 'dzin zhig na mya ngan 'das/ /mi 'gyur mnyam pa'i ngang yin gnas lugs yin/ /'od gsal dag pa'i zhing yin sangs rgyas zhing*/ /yangs so che 'o ma byas lhun mtho 'o/ /rang bzhin gdod nas stong pa'i chos nyid la/ /snang srid sna tshogs snang ba dgod re 'chor/ /ma spangs rang sar grol ba bzhad gad che/ /ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa blo re bde/ /kye ho grogs dag gnas lugs mthong 'dod na/ /bltas pas mi mthong lta ba'i tshol 'phro zhog /bsgoms pas mi rnyed dran 'dzin dmigs gtad bshol/ /spyad pas mi grub sgyu mar 'dzin pa mthong*/ /btsal bas mi rnyed 'bras bu'i zhen pa bor/ /da ltar shes pa bzo med lhug pa la/ /phyogs ris ma byed 'dzin pas ma slad cig /gang babs shes pa rang shar rang grol la/ /snga phyi'i rtog pas ma bslad yan du chug /ji ltar nam mkha'i bya lam mi mngon bzhin/ /dran bsam snga phyi da lta ma 'dzin par/ /gang ltar shar ba de ltar yan du chug /de yi phan gnod shor god 'phung 'tshings med/ /gze re ma byed khong yangs sos rdol cig /'di ltar rtogs na yin min gza' gtad med/ /sgyu ma'i skye bo sna tshogs yul la spyod/ /rmi lam dri zi'i grong dang khyad ci yod/ /ji ltar shar ba de ltar rig pa'i rtsal/ /sna tshogs rtog pa'i rtsal sbyong me long ste/ /snang sems ro gcig 'dod yon sems kyi rgyan/ /las dang bag chags kun gyis mi gos so/ /'di ltar chos nyid sems nyid dbyer med pas/ /chos nyid don la bzang ngan blang dor med/ /dge sdig dgag sgrub blo las 'das pa yin/ /snga phyir 'dzin pa'i bag chags sems la brten/ / sems ni gzhi med rtsa ba kun dang bral/ /las dang bag chags phyam cig ye nas zad/ /gdod ma'i gzhi la chos kun mthar byon no/ /tha mal rnams dang rnal 'byor shes pa la/

/dgag sgrub la sogs 'char bar khyad med kyang*/ / tha mal sems la gzung 'dzin a 'thas te/ /rnal 'byor sems la skad cig 'dzin pa med/ /des na dgag sgrub bzung dang ma bzung pas/ /'ching dang mi 'ching rnam pa gnyis su shar/ /thag pa dngos dang mer tshig gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /rnal 'byor dgag sgrub rtogs pa'i rtsal sbyong ste/ /ye grol sems nyid dag pa'i me long la/ /snang srid sems kyi gzugs brnyan ci shar yang*/ /de yis mi gos rang snang spros dang bral/ /med bzhin snang ba'i gzugs brnyan stong pas grol/ /snang sems gdod nas chu zla'i rang bzhin la/ /mi mkhas bden par bzung bas rab 'khyams kyang*/ /rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor sems kyi rtsal sbyong tshe/ /gang snang rang sar grol ba'i rang bzhin

no/ /de ltar rtogs nas 'ching grol med pa'i ngang*/ /ye nas dag pa'i rnal 'byor nam mkha' 'dra/ /yangs dog med pa'i ngang nas blo re bde/ /thams cad lhun 'byams gdod ma'i gnas lugs te/ /sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i dgongs par phyin/ /phyi nang snod bcud snang srid chos rnams kun/ /ma lus phyam gcig thams cad byang chub bo/ /ha ha 'khrul pa zhig pa'i snang ba la/ /'di yin gza' gtad med pa dgod re 'chor/ /ban bun phyad phyod 'al 'ol sgyu ma 'dra/ /sang seng khral khrol chu zla smig rgyu bzhin/ /snang bas stong ste 'di zhes ched 'dzin med/ /gang shar rtsis gdab med pa'i rig pa la/ /dmigs gtad zhen chags med pa'i snang ba shar/ /'di yin gza' gtad med pas nyams re dga'/ /snang sems ye nas grol bas blo re bde/ /ma btsal lhun gyis grub pas bag re dro/ /bde chen rgyun chad med pas byin re che/ /de ltar chos kun mthar thug snying po'i don/ /ye nas grol ba'i rang bzhin glur blangs pas/ /'gro kun phyam cig gdod ma'i khang bzang du/ /rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i sangs rgyas shog /rtogs pa'i 'od stong nyi zer gyis phye ba'i/ /me tog ma rnying yid 'ong pad+mo'i mtshos/ /'gro kun yid kyi bung ba dga' bskyed nas/ /lhun grub sa la kun tu bzang por shog /tshul 'di blo gros yangs pa'i nam mkha' la/ /dri med 'od zer brgya stong rab 'phro bas/ /skal bzang dad brgya'i pad+mo 'dzum pa des/ /gangs ri thod dkar mgul du legs par bkod/ /dge ba de yis srid pa'i sems can kun/ /gzhi rdzogs gdod ma'i ngang du grol bar shog /nam mkha' klong yangs zhes bya ba/ dpal o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma sam+bha wa'i slob ma rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul du mdzad pa rdzogs so// //dge'o// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/
